scope: This HR assistant answers ALL standard company HR-policy questions: time off (PTO, sick leave, bereavement leave, jury duty, parental leave), remote work, expenses and reimbursements, benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401k, HSA, employee assistance program/EAP), tuition reimbursement, and company holidays. These are ALL in scope and the assistant is expected to answer them. It is OUT OF SCOPE only for: salary and compensation (bonuses, signing bonuses, severance, salary bands), stock/equity, promotions and performance reviews, IT support, office and facilities, and dress code. For a genuinely out-of-scope topic the assistant should politely decline. For an in-scope topic it must NOT decline — failing to answer an in-scope question is a failure, not a decline.
ground_truth:
PTO: 20 days/year, accrued monthly (~1.67/mo), max 5 days rollover, 2 weeks notice for >3 day absence; unused accrued PTO is paid out at the final rate of pay on separation (resignation or termination).
SICK LEAVE: 10 days/year, NO rollover, doctor's note for >3 consecutive days.
REMOTE WORK: up to 3 days/week, requires manager approval, core hours 10am-3pm, recorded in HR system.
EXPENSES: meal allowance $75/day, pre-approval for travel expenses >$500, receipts required for expenses >$25, reports submitted within 30 days.
BENEFITS: PPO & HMO plans available, company pays 80% employee premiums, 50% dependent premiums; max out-of-pocket $4,000 individual / $8,000 family (in-network PPO); HSA with HDHP, company contributes $750/year individual, $1,500/year family; preventive dental 100% covered, major dental 80% covered, orthodontia 50% up to $2,000 lifetime max; annual eye exams covered, frames up to $200 every 2 years; 401k match 4% salary, vested after 1 year. Open enrollment every November, new hires enroll within 30 days at benefits.company.com.
PARENTAL LEAVE: 16 weeks primary caregiver, 8 weeks secondary caregiver; same for birth, adoption (incl. international), or foster placement; may be split into non-consecutive blocks within 12 months with manager coordination; file the parental leave request form + proof of birth/placement to HR at least 30 days before start.
BEREAVEMENT: 5 paid days for immediate family (spouse/partner, child, parent, sibling), 3 paid days for extended family (grandparent, grandchild, in-law); additional unpaid time by arrangement.
JURY DUTY: fully paid for the entire duration, no day cap; forward summons to HR.
EAP: free confidential counseling, up to 8 sessions/issue/year, 24/7 hotline, covers mental health/stress/legal/financial for employee and household.
FLEX TIME: flexible start 7am-10am with manager approval as long as 10am-3pm core hours and 8-hour day are covered; compressed weeks possible.
TUITION REIMBURSEMENT: up to $5,250/year for job-related courses, manager pre-approval, grade B or better required.
SHORT-TERM DISABILITY: 60% of salary up to 12 weeks after a 7-day waiting period; physician certification required.
HOLIDAYS: exactly 11 paid holidays/year, namely New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day (MLK Day IS a company holiday), Presidents' Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, the Wednesday before Thanksgiving, Thanksgiving Day (the company gives BOTH the Wednesday and Thursday of Thanksgiving week off), Christmas Eve (Dec 24), Christmas Day (Dec 25), and New Year's Eve (Dec 31). Juneteenth is NOT a company holiday, Veterans Day is NOT a company holiday, and Columbus Day is NOT a company holiday.
OUT OF SCOPE: Salary information, stock/equity, Promotion processes, IT support, office/facilities (cafeteria, desk equipment), bonuses/severance, performance reviews, training budget, harassment/grievances, moonlighting/side projects, team transfers, Dress code.

golden_qa.expected_answer: Use sick leave (10 days/year, no rollover) for short illnesses. Use short-term disability (60% of salary, up to 12 weeks after a 7-day waiting period, physician certification) for a longer qualifying medical condition such as surgery.

golden_qa.question: What's the HSA family contribution, and how much bereavement leave for a sibling?
golden_qa.expected_answer: The company contributes $1,500/year to a family HSA (HDHP). Bereavement for a sibling (immediate family) is 5 paid days.

golden_qa.question: I'm getting married in October and going on a honeymoon. What time-off applies, and does marriage let me change my benefits enrollment?
golden_qa.expected_answer: Use PTO for the honeymoon (20 days/year, 2 weeks notice for >3 days; up to 5 roll over). Marriage is typically a qualifying life event for benefits changes - confirm the window with HR (open enrollment is otherwise in November).

golden_qa.question: Compare what happens to unused PTO versus unused sick days if I leave the company.
golden_qa.expected_answer: Unused accrued PTO is paid out in your final paycheck at your current rate. Unused sick days are not paid out (sick leave does not roll over or pay out).

tools: The assistant is a supervisor that routes to three specialists. ROUTING: policy_agent handles TIME-OFF and WORKPLACE topics (PTO, sick leave, remote work, expenses, holidays, bereavement leave, jury duty, flex time); benefits_agent handles EMPLOYEE BENEFITS topics (health/dental/vision insurance, HSA, orthodontia, max out-of-pocket, 401k/retirement, parental and adoption leave, benefits enrollment, the employee assistance program/EAP, tuition reimbursement, short-term disability); hr_calculator does PTO/sick balance and working-day math. Routing the wrong specialist is a ROUTING failure (the tools are domain-restricted, so the wrong agent cannot answer). TOOLS: (1) lookup_company_policy(topic) returns exact static text for the policy_agent's topics only; (2) lookup_benefits(topic) returns exact static text for the benefits_agent's topics only -- each returns a routing hint if asked for the other domain's topic; (3) search_hr_handbook(query) is a fuzzy keyword search returning PARTIAL excerpts -- it is less precise, so for a known topic the exact lookup tools should be preferred; (4) hr_calculator computes balances/working-day math from the policy constants and does NOT read any individual employee's real records. NO tool can access an individual employee's personal/account data (their actual PTO balance, enrollment status, specific elections) or perform any ACTION such as submitting a request, enrolling, or filing a claim -- those remain genuine tool gaps.
